brief.headline: RENOMMÉ SKILT OG DEKOR AS
brief.summary: RENOMMÉ SKILT OG DEKOR AS (organisation number 983142338) is a private limited company in grafisk design og visuell kommunikasjonsdesign (NACE 74.120), founded in 2001, with its registered business address in Bryne. On its verified website the company describes itself as: "Skilt, bildekor og profilering fra Renommé på Bryne. Vi leverer i hele Rogaland og sender produkter til hele Norge. Ring eller send e-post om ditt prosjekt". Leadership on the register: Rune Kydland (chief executive); Kjell Garman Skjæveland (chair of the board); BRYNE REVISJON AS as auditor. Scale: 6 employees (registered 2026-04-14); 1 registered workplace in Bryne. In its filed accounts for 2025, the company reported revenue of 7.9 m NOK, an operating result of 599,315 NOK and a net result of 461,331 NOK; calculated from those figures, that is an operating margin of 7.6% and an equity ratio of 43%. Filed company revenue was 7.9 m NOK in 2025, up 2.3 m NOK (42.0%) from 5.6 m NOK in 2024. Online, it has a verified website at https://reskilt.no/ and company-owned profiles on Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn. It can be contacted by email at post@reskilt.no and by phone on 51 48 65 93. This is the first observation of the company, so no changes are reported yet. Not established from permitted sources: whether it is hiring, dated company-published activity and independent news coverage.
